items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: The interviewee describes Ed as 'a cook' who 'started a school there' and states 'I was a kid there', indicating no professional or personal musical connection is described.

ctx.x: Maybe that's the same fella I'm talking about. I know he played a nice bass and he used to read well because, uh, I used to rehearse with him a couple of times. Yeah, well, I started playing with him right down St. Peter Street where the Tonic Tribe used
to rehearse him. Because Ed, Ed, Ed, Ed, it takes some lessons, bass lessons from him.

He was a cook. Right, St. Peter between Liberty and Murray. He started a school there. Mr. Jones, the one with the Jones home? Yeah, yeah. He started a school there. And, uh, well, that's a long time ago. I mean, I was a kid there.
